entries.title: Genesis 37:1
segments: ¶And Jacob dwelt in the land where his father sojourned--in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 37:2
segments: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, fed the flock with his brethren; and he was doing service with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives. And Joseph brought to his father an evil report of them.

entries.title: Genesis 37:3
segments: And Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was son of his old age; and he made him a vest of many colours.

entries.title: Genesis 37:4
segments: And his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, and they hated him, and could not greet him with friendliness.

entries.title: Genesis 37:5
segments: ¶And Joseph dreamed a dream, and told [it] to his brethren, and they hated him yet the more.

entries.title: Genesis 37:6
segments: And he said to them, Hear, I pray you, this dream, which I have dreamt:

entries.title: Genesis 37:7
segments: Behold, we were binding sheaves in the fields, and lo, my sheaf rose up, and remained standing; and behold, your sheaves came round about and bowed down to my sheaf.

entries.title: Genesis 37:8
segments: And his brethren said to him, Wilt thou indeed be a king over us? wilt thou indeed rule over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams and for his words.

entries.title: Genesis 37:9
segments: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamt another dream, and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.

entries.title: Genesis 37:10
segments: And he told [it] to his father and to his brethren. And his father rebuked him, and said to him, What is this dream which thou hast dreamt? Shall we indeed come, I and thy mother and thy brethren, to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

entries.title: Genesis 37:11
segments: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying.

entries.title: Genesis 37:12
segments: ¶And his brethren went to feed their father's flock at Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 37:13
segments: And Israel said to Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed [the flock] at Shechem? Come, that I may send thee to them. And he said to him, Here am I.

entries.title: Genesis 37:14
segments: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see after the welfare of thy brethren, and after the welfare of the flock; and bring me word again. And he sent him out of the vale of Hebron; and he came towards Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 37:15
segments: And a man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the country; and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

entries.title: Genesis 37:16
segments: And he said, I am seeking my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed [their flocks].

entries.title: Genesis 37:17
segments: And the man said, They have removed from this; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them at Dothan.

entries.title: Genesis 37:18
segments: And when they saw him from afar, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to put him to death.

entries.title: Genesis 37:19
segments: And they said one to another, Behold, there comes that dreamer!

entries.title: Genesis 37:20
segments: And now come and let us kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, An evil beast has devoured him; and we will see what becomes of his dreams.

entries.title: Genesis 37:21
segments: And Reuben heard [it], and delivered him out of their hand, and said, Let us not take his life.

entries.title: Genesis 37:22
segments: And Reuben said to them, Shed no blood: cast him into this pit which is in the wilderness; but lay no hand upon him--in order that he might deliver him out of their hand, to bring him to his father again.

entries.title: Genesis 37:23
segments: ¶And it came to pass when Joseph came to his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his vest, the vest of many colours, which he had on;

entries.title: Genesis 37:24
segments: and they took him and cast him into the pit; now the pit was empty--there was no water in it.

entries.title: Genesis 37:25
segments: And they sat down to eat bread; and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites came from Gilead; and their camels bore tragacanth, and balsam, and ladanum--going to carry [it] down to Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 37:26
segments: And Judah said to his brethren, What profit is it that we kill our brother and secrete his blood?

entries.title: Genesis 37:27
segments: Come and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites; but let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brethren hearkened [to him].

entries.title: Genesis 37:28
segments: And Midianitish men, merchants, passed by; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty silver-pieces; and they brought Joseph to Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 37:29
segments: And Reuben returned to the pit, and behold, Joseph [was] not in the pit; and he rent his garments,

entries.title: Genesis 37:30
segments: and returned to his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, where shall I go?

entries.title: Genesis 37:31
segments: ¶And they took Joseph's vest, and slaughtered a buck of the goats, and dipped the vest in the blood;

entries.title: Genesis 37:32
segments: and they sent the vest of many colours and had it carried to their father, and said, This have we found: discern now whether it is thy son's vest or not.

entries.title: Genesis 37:33
segments: And he discerned it, and said, [It is] my son's vest! an evil beast has devoured him: Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces!

entries.title: Genesis 37:34
segments: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth on his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

entries.title: Genesis 37:35
segments: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted, and said, For I will go down to my son into Sheol mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:36
segments: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt, to Potiphar, a chamberlain of Pharaoh, the captain of the life-guard.
